text: Erin Soto: Quick notes from today's usability test on the routing policies editor. Two persistent pain points: the placement indicator feels disconnected in narrow panes, and validation banners after a drop are not discoverable. Victor Huang: Repro'd on 1280px width. The insertion indicator (we called it the gutter) is getting occluded by the token counter and sticky group headers. Users thought their drop didn't register. Rina Park: Also saw priority numbers flip briefly during long list reorders. I think virtualized row recycling + recalculated indices mid-drag cause the flicker. Jared: Dev idea: compute the intended destination at drag-start and keep a lightweight "priority shim" visual (no reflow) that snaps to the nearest visible row. Avoid recomputing model indices while dragging. Sam (a11y): Accessibility checklist: 1) keyboard move needs a stable focus anchor (keep focus on source item), 2) live region should announce settled placements only, and 3) validation banners must be role=status and not steal focus. Sam (a11y): Proposed aria string for placement: ```div aria-live="polite" id="rp-live">Placement: 'Block GeoIP' moved to position 4 between 'Auth' and 'RateLimit'``` update after animation end. Throttle to 200ms. Rina Park: Microcopy idea: change terse "Rule invalid" to "Rule not applied: missing match clause. Click to edit or press E to open editor." Make the action visible and mention the hotkey. Erin Soto: UX tweak: when dragging in narrow mode, collapse token counters into the sim header (or fade to 30%) so the placement gutter remains clear. Show a tiny badge on the shim with the future priority number (#N). Victor Huang: Implementation constraints: virtualized list reuses DOM nodes, so map visual targets to a stable client-anchor-id on mount. Use that id to drive animations instead of DOM indexes. Also debounce simulate-run while dragging (250ms) and cancel inflight sims. Jared: Also, for toasts shown during preview, portal them into the preview modal root or raise z; but ensure they are role=status and aria-live=polite so they don't hijack focus. Sam (a11y): Reduced motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion — skip the easing and update placement instantly, but still announce with aria-live. Erin Soto: Quick CSS sample for the shim suggestion: ``` .priority-shim { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; opacity: .96; border-left: 2px dashed var(--brand-ink); min-width: 44px; } ``` reserve min-width to avoid layout jank. ops-bot: Reminder: design workshop Tuesday 9:30am PT. Agenda: priority shim visuals, keyboard announcement wording, virtual mapping approach, validation microcopy. Please upload 5-10s screen recordings to the doc before 8am. :spiral_calendar: Rina Park: I'll prototype a narrow-layout gif with the shim and collapsed counters and paste it in the doc. Will also run quick contrast checks for the shim badge and validation banner. Jared: I'll spike the stable client-anchor-id mapping and a dragState flag to suspend simulate-run. Will share a short clip of the no-reflow flow by EOD. Erin Soto: Perfect — thanks team. If anyone else hits odd edge cases while dragging (esp around collapsed groups), drop a quick repro gif here.
